source_clock.code: ClearAll[x3,x4,lam,gam,k,chi,r,h,dx3,dx4,dl,dr,dh]; s=x3+x4; f=lam s {gam,chi gam,k,-(chi gam+k)}; vars={x3,x4,lam,r,h}; dirs={dx3,dx4,dl,dr,dh}; jvp[v_]:=Sum[D[v,vars[[i]]] dirs[[i]],{i,Length[vars]}]; df=(lam (dx3+dx4)+s dl){gam,chi gam,k,-(chi gam+k)}; <|"energy_identity"->Simplify[Total[f[[2;;4]]]],"per_reference_JVP"->Simplify[jvp[f]-df],"physical_source_JVP"->Simplify[jvp[r f]-(r df+dr f)],"eta_clock_JVP"->Simplify[jvp[f/h]-(df/h-f dh/h^2)],"physical_eta_JVP"->Simplify[jvp[r f/h]-((r df+dr f)/h-r f dh/h^2)],"energy_JVP"->Simplify[Total[df[[2;;4]]]]|>

thermal_augmented_source.code: ClearAll[y2,y3,zeta,gam,lam,k,chi,dy2,dy3,dzeta,dl]; vars={y2,y3,zeta,lam}; dirs={dy2,dy3,dzeta,dl}; rhs=lam y2 {-gam,gam,gam,k,-(chi gam+k)}; jac=Table[D[rhs[[i]],vars[[j]]],{i,5},{j,4}]; dj=jac.dirs; <|"thermal_particle_source"->Expand[{2,3,-1}.rhs[[1;;3]]],"thermal_particle_JVP"->Simplify[{2,3,-1}.dj[[1;;3]]],"thermal_electron_source"->Expand[{1,2,-1}.rhs[[1;;3]]],"energy_source"->Expand[chi rhs[[2]]+rhs[[4]]+rhs[[5]]],"energy_JVP"->Simplify[chi dj[[2]]+dj[[4]]+dj[[5]]]|>
